usage.title: Plan usage
usage.lede: hiro runs on your Claude subscription. These limits are shared with your own Claude and Claude Code use.
usage.refreshStarted: Refresh started. New numbers arrive in a minute.
usage.warn80: Session usage is above 80%. New runs may pause before they finish.
usage.paused: New runs are paused at the plan limit until {time}.
usage.pausedNoTime: New runs are paused at the plan limit.
usage.source: Read from Claude Code's rate limit events. Includes your own Claude use on this account.

usage.help: Numbers come from the rate limit events Claude Code emits during each run. When hiro is idle, a tiny refresh run keeps them current.
